I wrote `component.html` in the task folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

It's the requests screen at 1280px wide, inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. It has the "Requests" heading, the "Search requests" field, the All, Open and Closed filters with All selected, the primary "New Request" button, and the table with all six rows.

- **Fonts:** DESIGN.md names Unbounded and Archivo, but the folder has no font files and you said not to use other assets. The page lists them first and falls back to system fonts, so it will only use them if they're installed on the machine.
- **Design rules:** I kept to the colors, type sizes, spacing and radii in DESIGN.md.
- **Additions:** Request names are links, and rows highlight on hover. I didn't add a nav bar or any other content you didn't list.

`session.json` was empty. `session.err` has one line saying the model name `claude-sonnet-5-5` wasn't recognized.
